{{Top|leg}}
The '''kus'nar gladiatorial games''' was a popular event on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]]. They were held in the [[Rols'Kus]], a 250,000-seat amphitheater. The [[Coynite/Legends|Coynites]] viewed the games as sport; games were held every night and during holidays, [[Local day/Legends|day]]-long contests were held. Contests included brawling and melee combat, shooting ranges for archaic guns, [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], and [[Bow/Legends|bows]]. Young warriors dream of being crowned the [[Tawws'Kroyn]], or "Most Honorable Champion Warrior."
